definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to an -ism noun ({主義|しゅぎ}) to label someone who holds or champions that ideology, principle, or way of life. The English equivalent is the "-ist" ending.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{平和|へいわ}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}だ。
{完璧|かんぺき}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}は{疲|つか}れやすい。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{自由|じゆう}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}として、{個人|こじん}の{権利|けんり}を{守|まも}る{活動|かつどう}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: As a liberal, she continues her activities to defend individual rights.

notes:
Compound of {主義|しゅぎ} (-ism, principle) + {者|しゃ} (person). Attaches productively to any -ism noun.

COMPOUNDS:
- {平和|へいわ}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}: pacifist
- {完璧|かんぺき}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}: perfectionist
- {自由|じゆう}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}: liberal; libertarian
- {社会|しゃかい}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}: socialist
- {個人|こじん}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}: individualist
- {菜食|さいしょく}{主義者|しゅぎしゃ}: vegetarian

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜{主義|しゅぎ}: the -ism itself, without the person
- 〜{論者|ろんしゃ}: theorist; advocate — used for someone who argues a particular position
